title: Block inner product value
statement: For $m\ge 7$, a sign-valued input $x$ with $2^m$ coordinates, and a block index $b<m$, the block inner product value is the parity inner product modulo two of the length-$2m$ block input selected by $b$.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of the block-coordinate selection and the parity inner product.
